title: Carve 0.2 options
description: The 19 options. There are no others (C2-H-137). An application may spell a name by the convention of its language. Sorted by name, by code point.

name.description: The name of the option as the documents write it.

kind.description: The kind the option list gives the option.

read_by.description: The stage that reads the option. `headingIds` switches a resolution result that the renderer reads.

type.description: `structure`: a value whose shape another document defines; `holds` names it in the words of the option list.

clauses.description: The clause ids of the six 0.2 documents that the row encodes. The row is normative together with these clauses.

values.description: The values of an `enum`. An unknown value is refused.

items.description: What an entry of a `list` or a value of a `map` is.

keys.description: What a key of a `map` is.

default.description: The default. `null`: none. Absent where the documents do not state the value as data.

default_from.description: The data file of this directory that holds the default of each entry.
